answer_2.quote: We consider a range of state-of-the-art text generation metrics (TGMs), such as BERTScore , MoverScore and BLEURT , which we repurpose for evaluating thematic coherence in microblogs...

answer_4.quote: Coherence annotation was carried out in four stages by three annotators. ... annotators evaluated tweet cluster coherence on a 3-point scale (Good, Intermediate, Bad).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators read each tweet, grouped them, then rated cluster quality on a 3-point scale (Good, Intermediate, Bad) and identified issues (Chained, Intruded, Random).
